title: Concept: Form submits over plaintext HTTP
description: A form action that points at plaintext HTTP in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: Whatever the customer types reaches the destination without transport protection, and the whole submission can be read or altered on the path.
applicability: Deployments that render a form action that points at plaintext HTTP into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: Whatever the customer types reaches the destination without transport protection, and the whole submission can be read or altered on the path.
